title: Patch 1.3.2.1
text: Released on 05/12/204 Addon: Restored a few functions that went missing from the API. Namely: api.Time:TimeToDate, api.Time:GetGameTime and api.Map:ToggleMapWithPortal Bug: A bug with the labor costs on the Dawnsdrop Pickaxe quest chain has been fixed Bug: If you were affected by your labor usage going negative on the Dawnsdrop Pickaxe quest chain, please submit a ticket. Bug: Fixed asset issues with the Nightfire Glider Bug: A bug where a larder would eat an item without replanting properly has been fixed Fishing: To better balance fishing's silver per labor ratio given its risk, SALTWATER fish have had their gold value increased by 20% Item: The stack size for Water has been increased to 10000 Localization: Fixed tooltip showing incorrect labor amounts for larders. Zone: The debuff preventing teleports after death in Halcyona/Hasla has been removed. An improved version will come out later to prevent backdooring, but the current implementation is not satisfactory at the time. Reverted the crafting materials for all proven warrior necklaces that originally used wisps. World Boss: Rangora, Morpheus, Nazar and Hanure will no longer despawn after 2 hours. Instead they will stay up until they are killed.
html:
Released on 05/12/204

  • Addon: Restored a few functions that went missing from the API. Namely: api.Time:TimeToDate, api.Time:GetGameTime and api.Map:ToggleMapWithPortal
  • Bug: A bug with the labor costs on the Dawnsdrop Pickaxe quest chain has been fixed
  • Bug: If you were affected by your labor usage going negative on the Dawnsdrop Pickaxe quest chain, please submit a ticket.
  • Bug: Fixed asset issues with the Nightfire Glider
  • Bug: A bug where a larder would eat an item without replanting properly has been fixed
  • Fishing: To better balance fishing's silver per labor ratio given its risk, SALTWATER fish have had their gold value increased by 20%
  • Item: The stack size for Water has been increased to 10000
  • Localization: Fixed tooltip showing incorrect labor amounts for larders.
  • Zone: The debuff preventing teleports after death in Halcyona/Hasla has been removed. An improved version will come out later to prevent backdooring, but the current implementation is not satisfactory at the time.
  • Reverted the crafting materials for all proven warrior necklaces that originally used wisps.
  • World Boss: Rangora, Morpheus, Nazar and Hanure will no longer despawn after 2 hours. Instead they will stay up until they are killed.
